blocks.h2: A Checkup for the Whole Building
blocks.body: In a two-flat or three-flat, some plumbing belongs to each unit and some is shared: the main water line, the sewer, the gas service and often the water heaters. A whole-building checkup looks at all of it in one visit. Owners get a single report on what's fine, what's wearing out and what needs attention soon, so repairs can be planned and budgeted together.
Each unit and the shared systems get a written summary: fine, worth watching or needs attention, with flat prices for any recommended work. Owners can plan repairs together.

blocks.h2: Plumbing Maintenance Questions From Ravenswood Homeowners

items.q: How often should I have a checkup?
items.answer: Once a year, especially in an older home.

items.q: Can you inspect a whole two-flat?
items.answer: Yes, both units and the shared systems.

items.q: Does the No Drip Club include checkups?
items.answer: The [No Drip Club](/no-drip-club) includes regular maintenance visits.

items.q: Can you tell me if I need to repipe?
items.answer: Yes. We check the type and condition of your supply pipe and the pressure.

items.q: Do you need to get into each unit?
items.answer: Briefly, yes, to check each unit's fixtures and shutoffs.

items.q: Can you check for galvanized pipe during a checkup?
items.answer: Yes. We'll tell you what you have and its condition.

items.q: How much does plumbing maintenance cost in Ravenswood?
items.preview: It depends on the visit. You'll approve a flat price first.
items.answer: It depends on what's included. You'll approve a flat-rate price before we start.
